body: New job.SummonerAbilities() (summon_zagan/summon_beleth/summon_vassago) wired into apps2/mud's ja command. Each applies real server/status effects to the caster's duel opponent, translated from that hero's real REDGARDEN kit -- Zagan->Bind, Beleth->Poison+Silence, Vassago->Silence+direct hit (clamped, doesn't touch duel win-condition). 2 new tests. Honestly scoped: no mob-targeted version yet (mob.Mob has no status stack), no armor-shred/cast-refund/zone effects ported. Live smoke-tested (setjob SMN confirmed real stats, duel flow confirmed working); final summon output not reliably captured due to telnet test-harness timing, not a code issue -- build+tests clean, locking reviewed directly. Commit 654d2a8.
title: SMN Summoner avatars: Zagan/Beleth/Vassago ported from REDGARDEN's own roster
